limitations.statement: Internal work required to obtain a step satisfying (2.9)–(2.10) is not bounded by the evaluation analysis.

No reference performance link is asserted: Theorem 2.5 remains a lead because the printed exact counts have unresolved terminal-step and indexing issues. This does not change the source Algorithm's rules.

variants.cost: One initial f(x0) evaluation. Each trial evaluates f once at its trial point. Each visit to Step 1 evaluates the gradient, including the initial and terminal checks; orders 2 through p are evaluated only when that check fails. Rejections reuse the derivative tensors and do not revisit Step 1. Computing/storing tensors, tensor contractions and solving the possibly nonconvex model are separate computational resources; this record gives no bounds for them. The model solver uses the cached Taylor coefficients and does not require additional original-f queries under the source's accounting.

variants.name: ARp Algorithm 2.1
variants.output: Current iterate x_epsilon=x_k in R^n satisfying the tested Euclidean gradient-norm threshold; includes immediate return of x0.
public_inputs: Integer p>=1, x0 in R^n, epsilon>0, sigma0>0, theta>0, 0<sigma_min<=sigma0, 0<eta1<=eta2<1, 0<gamma1<1<gamma2<gamma3.
L and f_low appear in analysis; Algorithm 2.1 does not require them as tuning inputs.
variants.query_and_update: Step 1: evaluate grad f(x_k); return x_k if its Euclidean norm <=epsilon, else compute orders 2 through p (empty for p=1). Define T_p(x,s)=f(x)+sum_{j=1}^p D^j f(x)[s,...,s]/j! and m(x,s,sigma)=T_p(x,s)+sigma||s||^(p+1)/(p+1). Step 2: find s_k with m(x_k,s_k,sigma_k)<f(x_k) and ||grad_s m(x_k,s_k,sigma_k)||<=theta||s_k||^p. For nonzero s, grad_s m=grad_s T_p+sigma||s||^(p-1)s. Step 3: evaluate f(x_k+s_k), set rho_k=(f(x_k)-f(x_k+s_k))/(T_p(x_k,0)-T_p(x_k,s_k)). Set x_{k+1}=x_k+s_k if rho_k>=eta1, else x_{k+1}=x_k. Step 4: choose sigma_{k+1} in [max(sigma_min,gamma1 sigma_k),sigma_k] if rho_k>=eta2; in [sigma_k,gamma2 sigma_k] if eta1<=rho_k<eta2; in [gamma2 sigma_k,gamma3 sigma_k] if rho_k<eta1. Increment k. After acceptance return to Step 1; after rejection return directly to Step 2 with cached derivatives at the unchanged point.
variants.requirements: Exact f and derivatives through order p. Source analysis assumes f:R^n->R is C^p, bounded below, and globally ||D^p f(x)-D^p f(y)||_T <= (p-1)! L ||x-y|| for all x,y, with L>=0 and Euclidean induced tensor norm. A model-step procedure must deliver both conditions (2.9) and (2.10).
variants.state_and_initialization: Set k=0, x=x0, sigma=sigma0 and evaluate/cache f(x0). Cache derivatives at the current point for reuse after rejected trials.
variants.tuning_and_stopping: Keep the stated constants fixed. Update sigma within the displayed intervals; the source permits any choice in each interval. Terminate only at Step 1 when ||grad f(x_k)||<=epsilon. Model-step acceptance conditions are required at every trial; no iteration cap or model-solver runtime guarantee is provided.
